course.title: Transport Phenomena in Materials
course.department: Department of Materials Science and Engineering

content.value: Consider a slab of thickness L and constant thermal conductivity k in which energy is generated at a constant rate of $g \circ w / m ^ { 3 }$ . The boundary surface at x = 0 is insulated and that at x = L dissipates heat by convection with a heat transfer co-efficient h into a fluid at a temperature $T _ { \infty }$ . Develop expressions for the temperature T(x) and the heat flux q(x) in the slab.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2021
